column7: Picks the credential-lock wait deadline from the caller's contention class, 2 s for Short (the probe, era discovery, close) and 90 s otherwise; a mistake would let a probe wait out its own timeout and rebuild, or fail a tool call that should wait and adopt the holder's token (MIK-8619).

Bounds the wait for the credential's in-process refresh flight by the caller's deadline and answers the marked busy error past it; a mistake would let a stalled holder wedge every refresh and token save behind it (MIK-8619).

The one predicate the busy-lock skip arms trust (probe, fill check, renewal, ops breaker, capability, token access): the marker with its colon; a false negative turns a busy lock into a rebuild, breaker sample, cooldown or login, a false positive swallows a real BackendUnavailable (MIK-8619).

Enters the non-interactive scope as the Short contention class for the probe, era discovery and connection close; a mistake would make those callers wait the 90 s budget past their own deadlines, or begin a login (MIK-8619).
Reads the caller's contention class, Long when no scope set it; a mistake would give every credential-lock waiter the wrong budget (MIK-8619).
